assumptions.statement: The repository provisional site and key-area polygons are used for intake generation only.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers, areas, diagrams and ratios must be recomputed after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines and statutory controls are not available.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states spatial intentions and design methods, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, existing-building survey, heritage control lines and municipal networks are absent.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are design prototypes; retain/renovate/demolish decisions require field survey and professional review.

assumptions.statement: City-agent services require public rules, data minimization, human override, audit logs and exit mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is described as approved deployment; each begins in a bounded sandbox.

assumptions.statement: Phasing, operators, funding and annual events are reference mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: No government commitment, investment promise, approval or guaranteed implementation is claimed.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used as transferable mechanism references, not as direct planning-control precedents.
assumptions.impact: Case facts do not establish local boundaries, indicators or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: The Beijing-Haidian-Jing-Zhang diagnosis is based on official desktop sources; parcel-level surveys, counts and stakeholder interviews have not yet been completed.
assumptions.impact: Problem types are evidence-backed, but their exact location, frequency, affected population and baseline values require field verification before targets are fixed.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap snapshot 2026-08-09 provides geographic context for roads, rail, waterways and named public resources.
assumptions.impact: It does not establish official boundaries, planning controls, ownership, collaboration agreements or utility alignments.

assumptions.statement: 7x24 footfall, rents, vacancy, turnover, operating costs and delivery demand have not been surveyed.
assumptions.impact: Commercial hierarchy and operating models are concepts; no revenue, rent, payback or subsidy claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Utility ownership, diameter, depth, capacity, condition and incidents are not available.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure drawings show systems, risks and coordination interfaces, not approved alignments or capacity conclusions.
